name: Nastya
desc: A resident of Okurov, transformed by Koshchei's experiments.

desc.text:
So I'm back here again... It looks just like before, except that seed looks like it's about to sprout, and new leaves are also growing...
My little bed... is now being used by another life... My blanket... My pillow, and my toys...
It doesn’t feel like my little corner anymore? But... this feels so strange. Mama is already here beside me, so why do I still miss it..?.
I can feel mama's hand stroking my hair. It hasn't turned into beautiful leaves and branches yet, but mama loves me all the same... "Good children go to sleep early," she says...

customize.text: Using bioalchemy, Koshchei the Immortal, also known as Doctor Moreau in Okurov, transformed each villager and united them to create a Perfect Tree. This entity transcends time and all forms of life.

customize.name: Immortal Construct
customize.desc:
A byproduct created by the alchemist Koshchei during his creation of the individual known as the Firebird.
Perhaps this was the gloomy alchemist's habit: whenever one experimental subject from a batch succeeded, all the others would be abandoned or disposed of as he pleased.
This derivative creation should have fused with some form of power and reached completion. Now, however, it can only wander endlessly through the mountain gorges as an incomplete, mindless beast.

customize.text: Zhara is a firebird created by Koshchei and the protector of Okurov.

customize.name: Furiosa
customize.desc: A Volkodlak archer who once nearly lost her life. After undergoing alchemical modification, her body's strength surpassed the limits of living beings, and she gained a measure of authority over trees. She was meant to cast off her former body and fully transform into a life-form beyond time, one closer to eternity. But at the final moment, she chose to abandon that path. And so, she remains in a state as though her body has been parasitized by trees.

customize.text: Nastya's idol and Volkodlak archer, transformed by Koshchei. She was meant to cast off her former body and fully transform into a Perfect Tree, but at the final moment, she chose to abandon that path and tried to stop Nastya.
